changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands math and comparison symbols: say "minus sign" / "less than" / "greater than" / "caret" / "tilde" (or "বিয়োগ চিহ্ন" / "ছোট চিহ্ন" / "বড় চিহ্ন" / "ঘাত চিহ্ন" / "টিল্ড চিহ্ন") and a sum or comparison dictates itself ("five less than ten" becomes "five < ten", "two caret three" becomes "two^three", "about tilde fifty" becomes "about ~fifty"). Minus, less-than and greater-than stay spaced; the caret glues both sides; the tilde sits before the word. Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
